title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and verified a numerical solver for the porous medium equation traveling wave ODE. The code uses RK45 integration with adaptive step-size control and event detection for the compact support boundary. Key results: (1) Machine-precision accuracy (error ~1e-16) when compared to analytical solutions, (2) ODE residual below 1e-10 confirming the solution satisfies the governing equation, (3) Successful handling of different porous medium exponents m. The report includes 8 figures showing saturation profiles, gradient profiles, residual analysis, phase portraits, parameter studies, and convergence analysis.
